# Bitunix.Net

> Strongly typed .NET client library for the Bitunix Spot and Futures REST and WebSocket APIs. Part of the CryptoExchange.Net ecosystem, with shared exchange-independent abstractions.

Bitunix.Net provides typed REST clients, Futures market and user WebSocket subscriptions, Spot WebSocket order queries, automatic socket connection management, HMAC credentials through `BitunixCredentials`, dependency injection helpers, local Futures order books, user-specific clients, Native AOT support, and CryptoExchange.Net SharedApis. It targets netstandard2.0, netstandard2.1, net8.0, net9.0, and net10.0.

REST methods return `HttpResult<T>` or `HttpResult`. Futures WebSocket subscriptions return `WebSocketResult<UpdateSubscription>`. Spot WebSocket order operations return `QueryResult<T>` or `QueryResult`. Always check `.Success` before reading `.Data`.

The client roots are `BitunixRestClient.SpotApi`, `BitunixRestClient.FuturesApi`, `BitunixSocketClient.SpotApi`, and `BitunixSocketClient.FuturesApi`. Spot REST is split into `ExchangeData`, `Account`, and `Trading`; Futures REST has the same three groups. Symbols use forms such as `ETHUSDT` on both surfaces.

Use the exchange-level `IBitunixSharedApiClient` aggregate for runtime capability lookup. Its four surfaces are `SpotRest`, `FuturesRest`, `SpotSocket`, and `FuturesSocket`; use an API root's `.SharedApi` when transport and trading mode are already known. Spot REST does not currently implement the shared ticker capability; use the direct `GetLastPriceAsync` method for Spot prices or use the Futures shared ticker capability.

- [Source Interfaces](https://github.com/JKorf/Bitunix.Net/tree/main/Bitunix.Net/Interfaces/Clients): Authoritative method names, parameters, callbacks, and result types

## Core API Map

- `restClient.SpotApi.ExchangeData`: latest price, order book, klines, symbols, exchange rates, assets/networks
- `restClient.SpotApi.Account`: balances, withdrawals, deposits, deposit addresses, Spot/Futures transfers
- `restClient.SpotApi.Trading`: place/cancel/query Spot orders and user trades
- `restClient.FuturesApi.ExchangeData`: tickers, order book, funding, klines, symbols, position tiers
- `restClient.FuturesApi.Account`: balance, trading settings, position/margin mode, leverage, isolated margin
- `restClient.FuturesApi.Trading`: Futures orders, positions, user trades, order history, and TP/SL orders
- `socketClient.SpotApi`: authenticated Spot order placement and cancellation queries; no Spot market subscriptions
- `socketClient.FuturesApi`: ticker, aggregated ticker, order book, kline, mark price, trade, and authenticated user updates

## Examples

```csharp
using Bitunix.Net;
using Bitunix.Net.Clients;
using Bitunix.Net.Enums;

var client = new BitunixRestClient(options =>
{
    options.ApiCredentials = new BitunixCredentials("API_KEY", "API_SECRET");
});

var result = await client.FuturesApi.Trading.PlaceOrderAsync(
    symbol: "ETHUSDT",
    side: OrderSide.Buy,
    orderType: OrderType.Limit,
    quantity: 0.1m,
    price: 2000m,
    tradeSide: TradeSide.Open);

if (!result.Success) Console.WriteLine(result.Error);
```

```csharp
var socketClient = new BitunixSocketClient();
var sub = await socketClient.FuturesApi.SubscribeToTickerUpdatesAsync(
    "ETHUSDT",
    update => Console.WriteLine(update.Data.LastPrice));

if (sub.Success)
    await socketClient.UnsubscribeAsync(sub.Data);
```
